_comment: User-scope MCP server templates for `claude mcp add --scope user`, drafted 2026-09-23 from the live host's ~/.claude.json mcpServers block (names, commands, args and env var NAMES only -- no credentials, tokens or host-specific secret values). ${HOME} and ${ECO_ROOT} are placeholders in this template's own convention (adoption/templates/*.template.*): render or substitute them for the target host before use; do not commit a rendered copy with literal paths back into this file. Changed 2026-09-25: serena runs Serena's own `serena` console script. `uv tool install` links it into ${ECO_ROOT}/bin when Serena is installed at the stack pin with the bootstrap's uv-tool layout: UV_TOOL_DIR="${ECO_ROOT}/python-tools" UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR="${ECO_ROOT}/bin" uv tool install --python 3.13 git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143 (adoption/bootstrap.md step 4a runs it; no bootstrap pin installs Serena). The 2026-09-23 entry named ${ECO_ROOT}/bin/serena-context, a wrapper local to that host (it set SERENA_HOME) that nothing in this repository creates; Serena reads SERENA_HOME itself and defaults to ~/.serena. The ai-memory URL is this repository's default bind, 127.0.0.1:49374 (recipes/README.md `ai-memory serve --bind`, AI_MEMORY_URL in adoption/hosts/example.json); the host's user-scope registration must name the port its own ai-memory unit binds. install_claude_profile.py renders only ${HOME} and ${ECO_ROOT}, and `claude mcp add` refuses a name that already exists, so on another port run `claude mcp remove ai-memory -s user`, then `claude mcp add --scope user --transport http ai-memory http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp`. To change only some servers, remove each one that should change (`claude mcp remove <name> -s user`) and rerun `install_claude_profile.py --only mcp` without --replace-mcp: that flag re-registers every differing server, ai-memory included.
